items.name: Meeting minutes
items.one_line: The official record of what a meeting decided, who attended and who will do what by when.
items.value_evidence: Routine company-secretarial and admin work; Indian board minutes are governed by ICSI SS-1.

sources.title: TaxGuru: Secretarial Standards on minutes (SS-1 & SS-2)
sources.supports: secondary summary of ICSI SS-1: minutes are a fair and correct summary, not a transcript; draft circulated within 15 days, comments within 7 days, final entry within 30 days

items.note: Indian board minutes: fair and correct summary, not a transcript; draft circulated within 15 days, final entered within 30 days (SS-1, via TaxGuru summary; check the ICSI text). Record decisions and dissent, not chatter.

items.name: Meme and meme-caption content
items.one_line: Meme template plus caption that makes a brand or page part of an internet joke or moment without reading as an ad.
items.value_evidence: Indian agencies sell meme marketing through networks of meme pages, increasingly in Hindi and regional languages (Elevate Network, Idiotic Media).

sources.title: Elevate Network: Top Meme Marketing Trends in India 2026

items.note: Paid placements on meme pages need ASCI-compliant disclosure. Copyright in the template image and in film stills still applies.

items.name: Motivational / inspirational speech
items.one_line: A speech designed to lift an audience's energy and commitment, built on personal story and a clear call.
items.value_evidence: Sold under speechwriting categories; school, college and corporate events in India commission them.

sources.title: Fiverr Writing & Translation: Speechwriting
sources.supports: speechwriting category exists on the Writing & Translation menu

items.note: Struggle, turn, lesson, challenge to the audience. Avoid cliches the audience has heard at every annual day; specific detail wins.

items.name: Native ad (Taboola / Outbrain style)
items.one_line: Headline and thumbnail copy for recommendation-widget ads that link to an advertorial or landing page.
items.value_evidence: Upwork has a Native Advertising hire category whose snippets name Taboola/Outbrain-style platforms

sources.title: Upwork: hire Native Advertising Freelancers
sources.supports: dedicated hire category; snippets name Taboola/Outbrain-style native platforms (page refuses fetchers; title/description seen in search results 2026-10-04, snippet-only)

items.note: Headline must match the landing page; clickbait headlines get rejected by the networks' policies.

items.name: Video news bulletin / anchor script
items.one_line: Spoken script for a digital or TV news bulletin: anchor links, story reads written for the ear, and cues for packages, graphics and supers.
items.value_evidence: Written by newsroom staff; Upwork lists newswriters as a job type ($34-$62/hr citing Glassdoor; 2026-01-21) but no bulletin-specific category exists.

sources.title: Upwork: 14 Types of Freelance Writing Jobs and What They Pay (published 2026-01-21)
sources.supports: Upwork's own list of freelance writing job types with typical hourly rate bands charged on Upwork (blog/web content $15-$35/hr, content writer $15-$40/hr, ghostwriter $20-$45/hr, script writer $30-$56/hr, email & newsletter $15-$40/hr; newswriters $34-$62/hr citing Glassdoor) and project lists per type

items.note: Write for the ear: one idea per sentence, attribution first ('Police say...'), numbers rounded. Hindi digital news channels use this heavily.

items.name: News explainer (what we know / why it matters)
items.one_line: Article that makes a current, complicated story understandable: what happened, how it works, why it matters and what comes next.
items.value_evidence: Journalism references list the explainer as its own story form; Fiverr's 'Informational' article type is the second-largest facet (3483 gigs on 2026-10-04).

items.name: News-jacking / trend-reactive post
items.one_line: Fast article or social post that connects breaking news or a viral moment to the brand's expertise while the topic is still rising.
items.value_evidence: Indian brands buy moment marketing through meme and social agencies (Elevate Network, Idiotic Media pages); the article form has no separate marketplace category.

sources.title: Elevate Network: Top Meme Marketing Trends in India 2026
sources.supports: Indian meme-marketing agency describing paid brand campaigns run through networks of meme pages, increasingly in Hindi and regional languages (vendor source, low confidence)

items.note: Speed matters but so do sensitivity checks: tragedies, disasters and political events are off-limits for brand humour; check ASCI and the platform's rules.

items.name: Novel / novel chapter (long-form fiction)
items.one_line: Book-length fiction, written and delivered chapter by chapter.
items.value_evidence: Reedsy's ghostwriting marketplace prices full-length book projects per 1,000 words.

sources.title: Reedsy: Find Book Ghostwriting Services
sources.supports: marketplace guide prices: book proposal $750-$10,000 (59 projects, 2026); book ghostwriting average $450 per 1,000 words (2,006 offers, 2025); short-form $500-$2,000

items.note: Each chapter needs its own turn and a reason to read the next. Word-count expectations differ by category; agent and publisher guidelines own the numbers.

items.name: Obituary
items.one_line: Article published after a death that reports the facts like news and explains what the person did and how they should be remembered.
items.value_evidence: Journalism courses treat it as a hybrid of news and feature; paid family death notices are a separate classified product. No freelance category found on 2026-10-04.
items.note: Verify the death with family or an official source before publishing; avoid speculative cause of death.

items.name: Obituary / death notice
items.one_line: A published notice of a death (newspaper, social media) with the person's life details and funeral or prayer-meet information.
items.value_evidence: Newspaper classifieds and families write these; little freelance market.
items.note: Name, age, date, family, short life note, prayer-meet or funeral details. Indian newspaper notices often include a photo and 'with deep sorrow' style opening.

items.name: Offer stack / offer page
items.one_line: Write-up of the full offer: core product, bonuses, guarantee, price anchor and deadline, as it appears on the sales page.
items.value_evidence: Usually a section of a sales page or VSL, not bought alone (no market list found)
items.note: Unsure: may be better as a technique (tech:) than a genre.

items.name: Strategy / OKR document
items.one_line: A plan that states where an organisation is going and how progress will be measured (objectives and key results).
items.value_evidence: Internal leadership document; consultants write them inside larger engagements.
items.note: Diagnosis, guiding policy, actions. Key results are measurable outcomes, not tasks. Narrative memos beat bullet decks for reasoning.
